definitions.explanation: The second-in-command within an organization or department. Ranks directly below the head (長) and acts as a substitute or assistant. Common in government agencies, corporations, and other organizations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧さん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{次長|じちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Tanaka was promoted to deputy director.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不在|ふざい}→不在：11302_fuzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{次長|じちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{代行|だいこう}→代行：11433_daikou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When the department head is absent, the deputy director acts in their place.

examples.japanese: {次長|じちょう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}えて→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧きた⟦{功績|こうせき}→功績：04143_kouseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められた→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
examples.english: His long years of service supporting the organization as deputy director were recognized.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {次|じ} (next, secondary) + {長|ちょう} (chief, head). Refers to the person who is second in command to a {長|ちょう} (director/chief). The exact English equivalent varies by context: deputy director, vice-chief, assistant manager, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事務次長|じむじちょう} (deputy secretary-general)
- ⟦{課長|かちょう}→課長：01075_kachou⟧・{次長|じちょう}・⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧ (section chief → deputy director → department head, typical hierarchy)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {副〜|ふく〜}: vice-/deputy- — a prefix used with titles ({副社長|ふくしゃちょう}, ⟦{副部長|ふくぶちょう}→副部長：23994_fukubuchou⟧), often interchangeable in meaning
- ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧: department head — the position directly above {次長|じちょう}
